name: Pyxai
all_locations: Port St. Lucie, FL, USA; Remote
long_description: Pyxai helps organizations evaluate, identify and source top talent by focusing on the best indicators of long-term job success, soft skills. Our proprietary, AI driven assessment tool helps organizations increase retention by at least 30% all while reducing the time to hire by more than 50%.
one_liner: An assessment tool that evaluates people to predict future success

Co-founder and an avid student of life. Always in beta.
Years working on proving the values of soft skills and culture values for the workplace. Hustling everyday to create the first unicorn focused on soft skills and culture.
Super excited about data, human behavior, and I/O psychology.
Enjoy reading, running, sci-fi movies, graphic design, cooking, baking, and painting.
